# relay

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
*Harness adapters, hook dispatch, and a host-local live-agent registry*

Relay normalizes lifecycle and tool-hook events from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,
and Antigravity into a host-local live-agent registry, dispatches synchronous guards
and asynchronous observers, and serves a durable question inbox for away-from-desk
decisions.

Authority: `docs/api.md`, `docs/registry.md`, `docs/adapters.md`, `docs/questions.md`
<!-- ops:identity end -->

## Install

`relay` requires Node >=22 (ES modules, Node built-ins; `jsonc-parser` is installed by npm with `relay` and used only by `relay install`). It is consumed as a git dependency pinned to an annotated release tag (`git+https://github.com/khughitt/relay.git#v<version>`).

For a local checkout or worktree:

```sh
just setup
```

**No live hook or OpenCode plugin is registered by installing this package.** Hook and plugin registration is explicit and evidence-gated (`relay install`).

## Usage

```sh
node bin/relay.js list --json
node bin/relay.js reap
node bin/relay.js hook --harness claude-code PreToolUse < payload.json
node bin/relay.js model --harness codex --pretty
node bin/relay.js serve
node bin/relay.js presence away
node bin/relay.js inbox list
```

Each hook entry written by `relay install` invokes `relay.js` through the installer's own Node binary (or `--node PATH` on Claude Code and Codex) so GUI-launched harnesses find Node >=22 without relying on `#!/usr/bin/env node`.

## Configuration

- **State directory:** `RELAY_STATE_DIR`, else `$XDG_STATE_HOME/relay`, else `$HOME/.local/state/relay` (must be owned by the current user with mode `0700`; existing `0755` directories are rejected with `IO_ERROR`).
- **Subscriber configuration:** `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/relay/subscribers.json` or `$HOME/.config/relay/subscribers.json` (mode `0700` directory, `0600` file), or `--subscribers FILE` on installed hooks.
- **Inbox HTTP & Tailscale guard:** `RELAY_HTTP_PORT` (binds `127.0.0.1`), `RELAY_SERVE_HOST` and `RELAY_SERVE_LOGIN`, and optional `RELAY_CLIENT_DIR`.
- **Opt-in Codex question connector:** `RELAY_CODEX_BIN`, `RELAY_CODEX_HOME`, `RELAY_CODEX_SOCKET`, and `RELAY_CODEX_EVIDENCE` (`docs/evidence/codex-question-0.166.0.json`).

## Layout

- `bin/relay.js` — CLI entrypoint (`list`, `reap`, `hook`, `install`, `rollback`, `model`, `serve`, `ask`, `inbox`, `presence`).
- `src/` — Core library, process/lock/registry bus (`src/bus/`), harness adapters (`src/adapters/`), hook dispatcher (`src/dispatch.js`), installer (`src/install/`), interaction store (`src/interaction/`), and inbox service (`src/serve/`, `src/routes/`).
- `integrations/opencode/plugin.js` — Extracted OpenCode plugin (exported as package subpath relay/opencode).
- `schemas/interaction/message.schema.json` — Packaged JSON Schema for interaction envelopes.
- `docs/` — Shipped public reference contracts and operator runbooks, plus contributor guides in the repository.
- `test/` — Runtime test suite, portable fixtures (`test/fixtures/handles.json`, `test/fixtures/ancestry.json`), and compile-time contract checks (`test/types/`).

## Development checks

Routine broad local checks are disabled by `.tt.toml` (`automatic_broad = false`) after [accepted hosted Node 22/26 verification](https://github.com/khughitt/relay/actions/runs/41063297144). Run focused tests and mandatory hygiene while working, and force the full gate when required:

```sh
just check-hygiene
just test-one test/cli.test.js
just docs
TT_FORCE=1 just check
just test-full
TT_FORCE=1 just gate
```
